_comment: Map each workflow id you registered with the API to what THIS box runs.
Copy to jobs.json and edit. The controller only ever runs what appears here —
a scheduled workflow with no entry is skipped with a warning, never fetched
Comment keys like this one are SAFE TO KEEP: the catalog loader keeps only
object-valued entries, so any string or array value is dropped cleanly. JSON
gives you no other way to annotate a file, and a catalog benefits from notes.
`async-energy-controller register` writes entries here for you, including the
workflow id, so you never copy a UUID by hand. `--check` validates the result.
